'''Drukus Kain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Draenell's Point]]. Ostensibly a "farm tools" manufacturer, he made illegal weapons for the planet's criminal element. Once the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a presence on the planet, he began to supply weapons to local gangs in the hopes that they would use them to oppose the Empire.
